hiw_step1_desc: Fill in a detailed questionnaire about your needs — situation, interests, duration, style.
hiw_step2_desc: I read your questionnaire and confirm receipt. You know I've got it.
hiw_step3_desc: Based on your requests, I confirm the final price. You accept and pay.
hiw_step4_desc: I build your personalised guide. The guide goes live on the platform.
manifesto_p1: A few months ago, I closed the door of my apartment in Milan for the last time. I had a suitcase and a one-way ticket to Minneapolis. No roadmap. No manual. No one who had done exactly what I was doing.
manifesto_p2: What I had was determination, a genuine love for discovering new places, and years of experience planning trips. I figured it out — and I wrote down everything so you don't have to start from zero.
manifesto_p3: Relocating taught me that moving to a new country is just travel — at a deeper, more permanent scale. The same skills apply: research, logistics, local knowledge, flexibility, and someone who's already been there to tell you what nobody posts about online.
manifesto_closing:
"I built Companion Away because I needed it and it didn't exist.
Now I want to be for you what I wish I had."
about_heading:
Hi. I'm Giulia.
I'm the person behind Companion Away — and yes, a real one.
about_text_1: I moved from Milan to Minneapolis a few months ago, fell in love with travel long before that, and decided to turn both into something useful for people like you.
about_text_2: This platform is my project, my experience, and my passion. Every plan that comes out of here goes through me.
